title: Marshal Averno
notes: Marshal Averno, the second Citizen Commander: the mirror. His army requires the Citizen faction for its buildings and the Ravel faction for the two cards that leak to him from the Ravel Nexus (Raider Contract, Runner Crew: each marked from ravel, and dealt only by a schedule slot that asks for that Nexus). His campaign is campaigns/averno.

card.title: Averno
card.subtitle: Your Commander
card.description: Marshal Averno fights in the front rank and presses forward. If he falls, the Nexus restores him a round late.

content.notes: Vasse's doctrine pressed forward: a melee Commander in the front rank, a little harder than a trooper, lighter than her. He charges: he turns to fight what comes within 12 columns or 6 rows of him where every other unit waits for 6 and 3, and takes his aura there. Forward Order presses: he and his units within a reach of 4 deal a quarter more with every hit. When he falls the Nexus files him a round late (roundsOut 1: the owner, 2026-10-14, "Maybe some commander will have this disadvantage that they stay out for a full round"). His glyph is a figure with its weight thrown forward. First fixtures, no balance claim.

powers.name: Forward Drill
powers.description: Forward Order reaches twice as far.
powers.notes: His skill, wider: the mirror of Vasse's Standing Order, on his aura that presses.

powers.name: Unfiled Ordnance
powers.description: Your troopers explode when they die.
powers.notes: Nobody authorized this (commander-armies.md, his few): a power that acts on the enemy through the troopers he spends, the Ravel way of ending, in a Citizen army.

powers.name: Raider Contract
powers.description: Two Ravel raiders fight for you.
powers.notes: From the Ravel Nexus, through no channel anyone has filed a form for: two raiders, the raid's own heavy, join at his Nexus and stay.

powers.name: Runner Crew
powers.notes: From the Ravel Nexus: four quick, fragile runners that burst when they fall.

restored: Back. Someone owes me a round.
first-contact: Hit them first. Hit them hard.
badly-hurt: I can walk. So I advance.
nexus-hit: Back to the Nexus. Then forward.
falls: Hold the line I gave you.
